checks: Same-camera e1 compaction: core/short rays 50–70%, warm shoulder/spread 60–80%, preserved saturated peak; disabled and isolated reflection/arc output exact.
baselineComparison: Same candidate with Lens Flare disabled; independent M2.6.1 build comparison is a separate gate.

fixture.terrain: bounded native ellipsoid meshes, plus Gaussian real mesh occluder

reference: Unity HDRP LensFlareSamples2: compare optical hierarchy in a Sun-left, planet-right composition. No reference pixels or assets enter rendering.

compactionProfiles.name: hero-1000x227-e1
compactionProfiles.method: Diffusion-only native output. Core width is sqrt of >=250 all-channel pixel area inside source +/-8% image width. Short-ray radius is last >=240 all-channel sample on the leftward horizontal five-pixel mean profile. Warm shoulder/spread radii are last mean RGB on-minus-off >=80/20 byte samples. Output-space metrics include the unchanged physical Sun and tone mapping; ratios are approximate visual footprints, not radiometric radii.
